independent_evidence.chain_and_block: Ethereum mainnet; block 15259101; Etherscan reports successful process(bytes) through Replica proxy 0x5D94309E5a0090b165FA4181519701637B6DAEBA and a 100 WBTC transfer

root_cause.mechanism_summary: The official post-mortem explains that an empty initial Merkle tree produced bytes32(0), initialization pre-approved the committed root by setting confirmAt[_committedRoot] to 1, and acceptableRoot accepted the zero-root path once block.timestamp was at least 1. process then accepted an unproven message because it checked acceptableRoot(messages[_messageHash]).
external_evidence_quotes_or_paraphrases: Nomad's official post-mortem says the Replica implementation failed to authenticate messages and allowed forged messages that had not already been processed.
The post-mortem identifies confirmAt[bytes32(0)] = 1 as the initialization condition that made acceptableRoot(bytes32(0)) return true.
The pinned Replica.sol source contains the matching initialize, acceptableRoot, and process paths at the recorded line ranges.
Etherscan independently reports block 15259101, successful process(bytes), a successful Process event, and a 100 WBTC transfer from the Nomad ERC20 Bridge.
The Nomad audit reference labels the issue QSP-19, Proving With An Empty Leaf.

reproduction.poc_source_provenance: Owned minimal fixtures derived from the independently pinned source mechanism; no third-party PoC code is imported or executed.
limitations: The owned fixture is a minimal explanatory model, not the historical Replica implementation.
The PoC does not fork mainnet and does not reproduce the full BridgeRouter or WBTC transfer path.
The on-chain transaction is verified, but the owned reproduction is intentionally not a mainnet fork reproduction.

detector_mapping.mapping_rationale: The current analyzer has no dedicated detector for message-proof validation or zero-root initialization. The existing Uninitialized Proxy detector is not semantically equivalent because this case concerns an initialized Replica state and an authentication predicate, not an uninitialized delegatecall proxy.
detector_mapping.not_covered_reason: No existing detector can be assigned without broadening the detector taxonomy; assigning one would overstate coverage and contaminate the real-world metric.

review.decision_rationale: Source pinning, independent incident evidence, exact line mapping, on-chain transaction verification, and an owned minimal reproduction are now present. Admission remains deferred because the owned reproduction is not a historical fork reproduction, the current detector layer has no semantically valid expected detector for this root-cause family, and a second independent adjudication is still required.
admission_requirements_remaining: Verify the deployed proxy-to-implementation mapping from immutable chain evidence.
Review the implementation mapping and root-cause record independently of analyzer and LLM output.
Decide whether this case remains an uncovered detector family or whether a narrowly scoped detector should be proposed as a separate design review.
Run and record the staged Static, LLM, Comparator, Invariant, PoC, and Full pipeline observations without treating PoC success as Ground Truth.
Obtain a second independent adjudication before changing the decision to admitted.
